title: Joint neutrophil and monocyte ratios did not improve cross-cycle depression-screen prediction beyond flexible marginal measures
abstract: A standardized log-NLR-by-log-MLR interaction did not establish added prediction of PHQ-9 >=10 from NHANES 2005–06 to independently sampled 2011–12: weighted Brier reduction -0.00000256; two-sample preprocessing-and-coefficient-refit PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00105703, 0.00005411].
